import Mathlib
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Rudin_exercise_4_12
  {α β γ : Type*} [UniformSpace α] [UniformSpace β] [UniformSpace γ]
  {f : α → β} {g : β → γ}
  (hf : UniformContinuous f) (hg : UniformContinuous g) :
  UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := by
  have hf' : Tendsto (Prod.map f f) (uniformity α) (uniformity β) := by
    simpa [UniformContinuous, Prod.map] using hf
  
  have hg' : Tendsto (Prod.map g g) (uniformity β) (uniformity γ) := by
    simpa [UniformContinuous, Prod.map] using hg
  
  have h_prod : Prod.map (g ∘ f) (g ∘ f) = Prod.map g g ∘ Prod.map f f := by
    funext p
    simp [Prod.map, Function.comp_apply]
    <;>
    aesop
  
  have h_comp : Tendsto (Prod.map (g ∘ f) (g ∘ f)) (uniformity α) (uniformity γ) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (Prod.map g g ∘ Prod.map f f) (uniformity α) (uniformity γ) := hg'.comp hf'
    have h2 : Prod.map (g ∘ f) (g ∘ f) = Prod.map g g ∘ Prod.map f f := h_prod
    rw [h2] at *
    exact h1
  
  have h_main : UniformContinuous (g ∘ f) := by
    simpa [UniformContinuous, Prod.map] using h_comp
  
  exact h_main
